metadata.description: Curated collection of Claude Code plugins, skills, references, and configurations for modern TypeScript/Bun development, SRE operations, and infrastructure management.

plugins.name: code-quality
plugins.description: OxLint, Biome, and Prettier configuration, linting skills, and pre-commit hooks for consistent code quality.

plugins.name: project-scaffold
plugins.description: Mise, justfile, devcontainer, and project template skills for bootstrapping new projects.

plugins.name: infra-ops
plugins.description: SRE commands for incident response, capacity planning, system health checks, and infrastructure analysis.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Superpowers teaches Claude brainstorming, subagent driven development with built in code review, systematic debugging, and red/green TDD. Additionally, it teaches Claude how to author and test new skills.

plugins.name: huggingface-skills
plugins.description: Build, train, evaluate, and use open source AI models, datasets, and spaces.

plugins.name: sentry
plugins.description: Sentry error monitoring integration. Access error reports, analyze stack traces, search issues by fingerprint, and debug production errors directly from your development environment.

plugins.name: hookify
plugins.description: Easily create custom hooks to prevent unwanted behaviors by analyzing conversation patterns or from explicit instructions. Define rules via simple markdown files.

plugins.name: security-guidance
plugins.description: Security reminder hook that warns about potential security issues when editing files, including command injection, XSS, and unsafe code patterns

plugins.name: plugin-dev
plugins.description: Comprehensive toolkit for developing Claude Code plugins. Includes 7 expert skills covering hooks, MCP integration, commands, agents, and best practices. AI-assisted plugin creation and validation.

plugins.name: skill-creator
plugins.description: Create new skills, improve existing skills, and measure skill performance. Use when users want to create a skill from scratch, update or optimize an existing skill, run evals to test a skill, or benchmark skill performance with variance analysis.

plugins.name: typescript-lsp
plugins.description: TypeScript/JavaScript language server for enhanced code intelligence

plugins.name: rust-analyzer-lsp
plugins.description: Rust language server for code intelligence and analysis

plugins.name: gopls-lsp
plugins.description: Go language server for code intelligence and refactoring
